fields.src:
public static inline function call(name:String, ?args:Array<Dynamic>)
		if (scripts != null) scripts.call(name, args);

fields.name: beatHit
fields.src:
public static inline function beatHit(curBeat:Int)
		call("beatHit", [curBeat]);
